boards.school_name: State University of New York at New Paltz
boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named campus spaces documented by SUNY New Paltz for studying, student organizations, arts, performances, and recreation.

cards.title: Student Union
cards.subtitle: 1 Hawk Drive · campus common space
cards.notes: Use the building directory to locate services or events, then pause in its shared areas between classes. Check posted building hours before arriving.
cards.short_summary: A central campus building for services, events, and shared time.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY New Paltz describes the Student Union as a common space for enrolled people, employees, and visitors to engage and access services.
cards.source_title: Center for Student Engagement: The Student Union
cards.access_notes: The university identifies it as a common space for visitors as well as campus community members; follow posted building hours and event restrictions.

cards.title: Student Union Ballroom
cards.subtitle: Student Union · renovated event venue
cards.notes: Look at the campus events calendar for a program in this room, or notice the upgraded stage, lighting, acoustics, and flexible event setup.
cards.short_summary: A renovated indoor venue for campus programs and performances.
cards.evidence_claim: The University reports that the renovated Ballroom supports speaking events, celebrations, panels, dances, performances, movie nights, and other programs.
cards.source_title: ‘Students will love this space’: Celebrating the new-and-improved Student Union
cards.access_notes: Room use depends on scheduled events; consult the campus events calendar or Student Union staff for entry details.

cards.title: Student Union eSports Center
cards.subtitle: Student Union third floor · gaming space
cards.notes: Ask Student Engagement about current eSports access or programming, then pair a visit with the nearby third-floor club and meeting spaces.
cards.short_summary: A modern gaming-focused space within the renovated Union.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY New Paltz lists a modern eSports Center among the renovated third-floor Student Union spaces.
cards.source_title: ‘Students will love this space’: Celebrating the new-and-improved Student Union
cards.access_notes: Access and use may be program-dependent; confirm with the Center for Student Engagement.

cards.title: Multi-Cultural Center
cards.subtitle: Student Union third floor · student-affairs space
cards.notes: Check with Student Engagement for activities or services in the center, and combine it with a walk through the Union’s renovated third floor.
cards.short_summary: A named cultural-center space in the Student Union.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY New Paltz identifies a Multi-Cultural Center as one of the renovated third-floor Student Union spaces.
cards.source_title: ‘Students will love this space’: Celebrating the new-and-improved Student Union
cards.access_notes: Confirm current programming and access with the Center for Student Engagement before treating it as a drop-in destination.

cards.title: Sojourner Truth Library
cards.subtitle: 300 Hawk Drive · library study floors
cards.notes: Choose seating that fits the task, then use the library’s collections, technology, and information services for coursework or independent research.
cards.short_summary: The campus library provides varied places to work alongside research resources.
cards.evidence_claim: The 2025–26 SUNY New Paltz catalog describes Sojourner Truth Library as a spacious facility with varied seating and workplace options.
cards.access_notes: Use the library’s current hours calendar and follow library policies; some reservable spaces have campus-only reservation rules.

cards.title: Sojourner Truth Library 24/7 Lobby
cards.subtitle: Sojourner Truth Library · after-hours study
cards.notes: Bring a valid campus ID for access after the library closes; the lobby has seating, tables, restrooms, vending machines, and a water fountain.
cards.short_summary: A card-access study option after the main library closes.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY New Paltz states that the Library’s Front Lobby provides students 24/7 access for study and requires a valid campus ID after main-library closing.
cards.source_title: Reminders for fall 2025 from Sojourner Truth Library on study spaces for students and faculty
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for students during the stated semester arrangement; after main-library closing, entry is card-only with a valid campus ID.

cards.title: Samuel Dorsky Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: Smiley Art Building · galleries and exhibitions
cards.notes: Visit during public gallery hours, then use the exhibition labels and current show pages to guide a self-paced art break between classes.
cards.short_summary: A campus art museum with changing and ongoing exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Samuel Dorsky Museum of Art says it is free and open to all, Wednesday through Sunday, 11 a.m.–5 p.m.
cards.source_title: The Samuel Dorsky Museum of Art at SUNY New Paltz
cards.access_notes: Current posted museum hours are Wednesday–Sunday, 11 a.m.–5 p.m.; exhibitions and special programs can vary.

cards.title: McKenna Theatre
cards.subtitle: College Theatre building · proscenium stage
cards.notes: Check the Theatre Arts season for a Mainstage performance, and arrive with time to find the College Theatre building and ticketing details.
cards.short_summary: A 358-seat theatre used for part of the department’s Mainstage season.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY New Paltz states that McKenna Theatre is a 358-seat proscenium theatre that hosts part of its Mainstage production season.
cards.access_notes: Attend through a scheduled performance or approved event; College Theatre is listed as unlocked Monday–Friday, 7 a.m.–9 p.m.

cards.title: Parker Theatre
cards.subtitle: Theatre Arts · intimate thrust stage
cards.notes: Watch the Theatre Arts calendar for productions in this 201-seat venue, or use it as a reference point when visiting the performance studios nearby.
cards.short_summary: An intimate thrust-stage theatre in the Theatre Arts facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY New Paltz identifies Parker Theatre as a 201-seat thrust-stage performance space with nearby performance studios.
cards.access_notes: Access is tied to scheduled performances, classes, or approved activities; verify event details with Theatre Arts.

cards.title: Athletic & Wellness Center
cards.subtitle: South of Elting Gymnasium · fitness and courts
cards.notes: Consult the full facility schedule before going, then choose a campus recreation activity or use the track and fitness areas if eligible to enter.
cards.short_summary: A 57,000-square-foot recreation facility with fitness areas, a track, and court space.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY New Paltz describes the Athletic & Wellness Center as containing wellness and weight-training centers, an overhead running track, and a basketball/volleyball court.
cards.access_notes: The current facilities page lists hours through 11 p.m. Monday–Thursday; eligibility and activity schedules are set by campus recreation.
